name: Yazaki
source:
Hoshimi's father. He is the instructor at the kendo dojo, but he also has black belts in karate and judo. He has been guiding Hoshimi strictly. He is a mild and polite person.

[Based on [url=http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/初恋サクラメント]Wikipedia[/url]]
